canonical_hash_recipe.adapter_publication_identity: Record the actual separate portable-adapter source commit, adapter SHA256 and handoff manifest SHA256 in the central assignment/lease. The inherited first-eight engine commit is not the adapter publication commit.
canonical_hash_recipe.algorithm: SHA256 over exact portable_pair.encoded(canonical_config) bytes; not evaluated by this protocol author
canonical_hash_recipe.platform_neutrality: Scientific identity excludes deployment paths, host names and current PID/lease state. Record deployment/runtime provenance separately; compare scientific aliases before assigning the same geometry through another wrapper.
required_domains: physical phantom geometry and coordinate system
electrode geometry/rotation/physical mask and node assignment
frequency-specific gamma and material source/receipt identity
contact zA and exact Rs/area model/receipt identity
source waveform/Vpp phase/convention/output resistor and inactive termination
number of pads versus independent outputs/return topology
canonical_hash_recipe.terminator: Append exactly one LF (U+000A) after json.dumps output
canonical_hash_recipe.unresolved_local_adapter_or_mask_fields: Root prepares exact canonical configurations through the frozen portable adapter and records actual adapter publication identity separately. This document calculates no candidate hash and grants no lease.

execution_scope.central: Only canonical-candidate overlap is exclusive; approved disjoint local/cloud calculations may run concurrently
execution_scope.cloud: Existing cloud queue/dual locks and one root owner stay unchanged
execution_scope.local: One verified Windows native owner/Job and local lock per local environment

acquire: Read actual current Git ref and immutable registry
Check canonical and symmetry aliases against active/completed/pending work
Create registry commit with exact expected parent and unique run/candidate identity
Nonforce compare-and-swap ref update; on mismatch reread, never force
Verify remote commit and exact registry bytes before starting a case

heartbeat.TTL: Expiry marks suspect_stale only; it does not prove process death or free a candidate
heartbeat.takeover: Verify actual PID+CreationTime or startticks, owner/Job state and checkpoint. An unreachable environment is not proof of death. Explicit root recovery/fencing and a fresh CAS are required before another owner starts the same case

identity.lease_id: Nonsecret unique identifier, not an access credential
identity.public_environment_id: pseudonymous environment label, not a host name

lease.private_runtime_pointer: Optional local runtime pointer is private and must not be published as the central registry
lease.publication_coordination: Root uses a safe cloud publication boundary so the registry does not invalidate an in-flight scientific publication parent; no global calculation stop is required
lease.worker_checks: Verify its own live process identity and current candidate lease before each new RHS/checkpoint/publication. If ownership cannot be confirmed, preserve partials and stop starting new work; do not delete original evidence.

symmetry_review.before_assignment: Compare latest cloud completed/active/pending registry using the full canonical physics and analysis payload, not proposal name or nominal pad count alone
symmetry_review.transforms: Only transformations preserving the actual fixed grid/material/circuit and registered ROI/measurement definitions may be aliases. Rotate/reflect pad positions together with their node/frequency labels. Exchanging f1/f2 outputs is not automatically an alias because gamma/contact/drive roles differ. Identical common-return labels may be exchanged only with otherwise identical models.
